scope: Targeted primary-source basis for a bounded three-moment maximum-entropy reconstruction, with emphasis on realizability, conditioning and atomic limits. Three studies; not a general survey.
evidence_state: Published mathematical/numerical method lineage plus explicit local specialization. The proposed sectional snow-collision adaptation has separate implementation and numerical controls; no physical snow validation is claimed.
external_bytes: No full papers or external datasets added to the repository. Web/PDF text extraction was inspected without retaining local byte hashes.

local_derivations: Normalized exp(A*x+B*x*x) specialization for number, mean and variance in a bounded mass cell.
Positive B is admissible on compact support; -2B < A < 0 yields an interior minimum on [0,1].
At symmetric mean 1/2, A = -B; uniform density has variance 1/12 and larger variance requires positive B.
Zero-variance and maximal-variance atomic limits, covariance Hessian, and preservation of the entropy reference under affine coordinate changes.
Numerical controls separate inversion, quadrature, time integration and distribution-shape closure.
method_status: Candidate local adaptation. Keep beta candidate files/results intact; numerical outcome and adoption decisions are recorded separately.
